The meal that comes second in the day, after breakfast, is lunch.

Regarding the thematic structure of the provided text, the author’s motive is to use the sunflower’s wilting as a botanical metaphor to explore the consequences of neglect on both nature and human relationships. This motive is structurally linked to the theme of isolation and decay; just as the sunflower withers without care, the protagonist’s emotional state deteriorates due to her isolation. The narrative structure mirrors this thematic arc by moving from the protagonist’s pride in the garden to her sadness as the plant dies, thereby illustrating the natural cycle of life and decay and urging readers to reflect on the importance of connection and maintenance in personal relationships.
